hadith:
Mortgaging - Narrated `Aisha:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought some foodstuff from a Jew and mortgaged his armor to him.
message: The Quran reminds us to be mindful of our choices and seek help when needed. The Prophet Muhammad's example shows us the value of seeking provisions through permissible means. Reflecting on Allah's attributes like Al Mudhil encourages humility and adherence to righteous paths.
name:
Al Mudhil - المُذِلُّ - The Humiliator

Al Mudhil refers to Allah's attribute of causing disgrace or humiliation to those who oppose His commands or reject His guidance. This name emphasizes the power of Allah to elevate or debase individuals based on their actions and faith. It serves as a reminder of the consequences of turning away from righteousness and the importance of adhering to divine guidance.
verse:
Al-'Alaq - The Clot - 96:17

So let him call his associates.
